en: Psalms 51
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.

zh: 大衛與拔示巴同室以後，先知拿單來見他；他作這詩，交與伶長。

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。預言者ナタンが彼のもとに来たとき、すなわち彼がバテ・シェバのもとに行った後。

p.src: 1  Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

en: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
u.src: 1  Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

p.src: 2  Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

en: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
u.src: 2  Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

p.src: 3  For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

en: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
u.src: 3  For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

p.src: 4  Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

en: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
u.src: 4  Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

p.src: 5  Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

en: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
u.src: 5  Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

p.src: 6  Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

ja: よ、あなたは心の奥に真実を望まれる。 あなたは私の内なる深い所で、
en: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
u.src: 6  Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

en: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
u.src: 7  Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

p.src: 8  Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

ja: かせてください。 あなたに打ち
en: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
u.src: 8  Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

p.src: 9  Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

ja: を隠し、 私のすべての
en: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
u.src: 9  Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

p.src: 10  Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

en: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
u.src: 10  Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

p.src: 11  Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

ja: てないでください。 あなたの
en: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
u.src: 11  Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

p.src: 12  Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
u.src: 12  Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

p.src: 13  Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
u.src: 13  Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

en: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

en: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
u.src: 15  Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

en: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
u.src: 16  For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

p.src: 17  The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

ja: よ、あなたは砕かれ、悔いる心をさげすまれない。
en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
u.src: 17  The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

en: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
u.src: 18  Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

p.src: 19  Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

en: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
